title: Google Calendar
description: To create and list meetings through WhatsApp. The calendar permission is only asked for here, never at sign-in.

locked.line: Available on Premium, together with Vera on WhatsApp.

unavailable.selfHosted: No Google keys in this installation.
unavailable.hosted: Google Calendar is unavailable right now.

revoked: The permission was revoked at Google. Connect again.

permission.readWrite: Permission: view and edit events on the main calendar.
permission.readOnly: Permission: view events on the main calendar only.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Google Calendar?
disconnect.text: Vera stops creating and listing meetings. The permission is revoked at Google.

modal.title: Connect Google Calendar
modal.intro: You will go to Google to authorize. At sign-in Vera only received your name and e-mail; the calendar is asked for now, separately.
modal.permissionTitle: Permission requested: view and edit events
modal.permissionText: To create the meetings you ask for on WhatsApp and list your upcoming events.
modal.notAccessedText: E-mails, contacts and files. You can revoke access here or in your Google Account.

events.title: Upcoming events
events.empty: No events in the next 7 days.
events.error: Could not read the calendar right now.

toasts.disconnected: Google Calendar disconnected and permission revoked

errors.generic: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
errors.consentDenied: You did not authorize the calendar. Nothing was connected.
errors.scopeMissing: The permission to view and edit events was not checked. Connect again and check the option.
errors.providerUnavailable: Google did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.
errors.providerDisabled: Google Calendar is unavailable right now.
